attempted_claim: Let P(z)=z^3+c be an infinitely renormalizable unicritical cubic polynomial in the combinatorial class constructed by Inou–Wang in Combinatorial non-rigidity for infinitely renormalizable unicritical cubic polynomials — i.e. an infinitely renormalizable z^3+c whose infinite renormalization combinatorics supports distinct combinatorially equivalent but non-hybrid-equivalent maps — with all periodic points repelling. Is the Julia set J(P) (filled Julia set K(P)) locally connected? Determine this via shrinking of Yoccoz puzzle pieces / modified-principal-nest moduli and the Thurston-pullback obstruction in the absence of parameter rigidity.
decisive_failure: Local connectivity in the Inou-Wang class remains undetermined: the repelling hypothesis yields no quantitative nest-modulus bound, degree-2 collar machinery does not transfer to the engineered degree-3 combinatorics, the Thurston pullback is non-contracting along the non-rigid manifold, and the recovery script only models the gap rather than closing it. Resolution needs new a priori bounds or an explicit non-shrinking fiber construction.
